web_fetch.name: Fetch Web Content
web_fetch.description: Fetch web page content and convert to markdown. Actions: fetch(url, use_webview=false).

read_skill.name: Read Custom Skill
read_skill.description: Read the full workflow document of a specified custom Skill under data/storage/ai/agent/skills. Supports reading sub-file paths.

create_skill.name: Create/Update Skill
create_skill.description: Create or update the skill.md content of a custom Skill in Agent mode.

inbox.name: Inbox Management
inbox.description: Inbox management (cloud-clipped web pages, messages, and audio/video/file attachments; requires subscription). Actions: list(page=1), get(id), convert(ids, notebook, path=/, remove_after=true) — converts one or more shorthands into local documents under the target notebook, deleting the cloud originals on success.

sync.name: Data Sync
sync.description: Data sync operations. Actions: perform() (full upload+download), upload(), download(), status().

system.name: System Info
system.description: System info. Actions: version(), current_time(), workspace().

template.name: Template Management
template.description: Template management. Actions: search(keyword?), get(path), remove(path), render(path, id), save_as(id, name, overwrite?), create(name, content, overwrite?).

export.name: Export Operations
export.description: Export operations. Actions: md(id), html(id), preview(id), docx(id, output path), sy(id) -> .sy.zip, md-zip(id), data() -> full workspace backup.

ref.name: Reference and Links
ref.description: Reference/backlink operations. Actions: backlinks(id, keyword?, sort?), mentions(id, keyword?, sort?), refresh(id).

repo.name: Repository Management
repo.description: Cloud repository endpoint management. Actions: list(), get(id), remove(id), push().

skill.name: Skill Management
skill.description: Knowledge base / skill management. Actions: list(), get(id), remove(id), save(id, name, content).

document.name: Document Operations
document.description: Document lifecycle operations. Actions: create(), remove(), rename(), move(), get_tree(), list().

history.name: History Management
history.description: Document version history management. Actions: list(), revert(), compare().

question.name: User Question Dialog
question.description: Prompt user for questions/confirmation. Actions: ask(questions, submit_button_text).

block.name: Block Operations
block.description: Siyuan block level operations. Actions: get(id), insert(id, content, parentId?), append(id, content), update(id, content), remove(id), get_kramdown(id).

attr.name: Custom Attributes
attr.description: Block custom attribute operations. Actions: get(id), set(id, attrs), batch_get(ids).

import.name: Import Operations
import.description: Import operations (absolute local paths). Actions: md(notebook, path, targetPath?), sy(notebook, path, targetPath?), data(path).

unzip.name: Unzip Operations
unzip.description: Extract a zip archive within the workspace (workspace-relative paths).

bookmark.name: Bookmark Management
bookmark.description: Bookmark management. Actions: list(), labels(), remove(label), rename(old, new).

file.name: File Operations
file.description: Workspace file operations (paths relative to workspace; debugging/log reading only — never use for workspace data). Actions: list(path, limit), read(path, offset, limit), write(path, data), delete(path), rename(old, new), copy(src, dst), grep(pattern, path), find(path), stat(path).

http_request.name: HTTP Request
http_request.description: Send custom HTTP requests. Actions: request(url, method, headers, body).

notebook.name: Notebook Management
notebook.description: Notebook management and configuration. Actions: list(), create(name), get_conf(id), set_conf(id, conf), remove(id), status(id).

asset.name: Asset Management
asset.description: Asset file operations. Actions: upload(), get(), remove().

dailynote.name: Daily Note Operations
dailynote.description: Daily note management. Actions: get(notebook, date?), create(notebook, date?).

database.name: Attribute View (Database)
database.description: Attribute View (Database) operations. Actions: list_keys(avId), render(avId), append_detached(avId, values), add_blocks(avId, blockIds), set_block_attr(avId, blockId, key, value), add_key(avId, key), remove_key(avId, key), remove_blocks(avId, blockIds).

sql.name: SQL Query
sql.description: Query Siyuan database directly via SQL. Actions: query(sql), refresh().

tag.name: Tag Management
tag.description: Tag management. Actions: list(), remove(tag), rename(old, new).

web_search.name: Web Search
web_search.description: Search the web using search engines. Actions: search(query).

frontend.name: Frontend Interaction
frontend.description: Frontend UI interactions. Actions: notify(message, type).

search.name: Content Search
search.description: Full text search in notebooks. Actions: query(k), embed(k).

multiModel.waitingSelection: Please select a satisfactory answer before continuing the conversation
